MwEditScriptTest.esp is MWEdit's own compiler test plugin (data/MwEditScriptTest.esp in
https://github.com/Walrus-Tech/MWEdit), MIT-licensed: see LICENSE.txt beside it. Its 34
scripts carry MWEdit's compiled bytecode, which tests/test_mwscript_compiler.py
checks wraithguard.mwscript.compiler against byte for byte. Not a game file.
